gathering.speaker: Margaret
gathering.text: Coats on the back pews. We start when you do.

welcome.speaker: You
welcome.text: Good morning. Thank you for coming. One short word, then we go.

sermon.speaker: You
sermon.text: The room can hold one honest thing this week.

choices.text: Hope. The tiredness is real, and so is the next morning.
Forgiveness. No names. The hurt in the room is still allowed.
Service. Faith that picks up a screwdriver.

hope.text: The room sits a little taller. Nobody claps. A child swings their feet and stays.

forgiveness.text: Frank looks at the floor, then at the window. The hymn book stays in his lap.

service.text: Harold nods once, the way he does at a list. Thomas is already counting chairs.

hall_ask.speaker: Margaret
hall_ask.text: The Fellowship Hall has been boarded since before you arrived. If we put the plate toward it, Harold can make it hold people again.

hall_choice.speaker: Margaret
hall_choice.text: I'm not asking you to promise a cathedral. I'm asking whether the hall is worth opening.

hall_yes.speaker: Margaret
hall_yes.text: Good. The ledger is the place for the rest. I will not read numbers in the aisle.

hall_wait.speaker: Margaret
hall_wait.text: Then it waits. The ledger is still on the west table when you want it.

close.speaker: Margaret
close.text: The ledger is on the west table. Same as last week. We keep saying it out loud.
